channel.title: Book Summaries: Additional Requested Books
channel.description: Discover comprehensive book summaries covering self-help, business, psychology, relationships, productivity, and classic novels. Get key insights and takeaways from bestselling books in minutes.

item.title: Letters from a Stoic by Seneca
item.description: Seneca's letters on building sound judgment, using time well, facing uncertainty, and caring for others without making fortune the measure of a good life.

item.title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant by Eric Jorgenson
item.description: Naval Ravikant's ideas on building wealth through ownership, judgment, and leverage, and finding peace without waiting for the next achievement.

item.title: The Art of Worldly Wisdom by Baltasar Gracián
item.description: Gracián's guide to practical judgment: govern your reactions, read people carefully, choose the right moment, and balance worldly success with integrity.

item.title: The Bed of Procrustes by Nassim Nicholas Taleb
item.description: Taleb's aphorisms challenge the urge to force life into tidy models, exposing self-deception, status dependence, and the limits of expert certainty.

item.title: The Beginning of Infinity by David Deutsch
item.description: How good explanations, criticism, and creative knowledge can support open-ended progress—and why that progress is never guaranteed.

item.title: The Republic by Plato
item.description: Plato's case for justice as inner order, explored through the ideal city, philosopher rulers, the cave, and the dangers of unchecked desire.

item.title: The Tao Te Ching by Lao Tzu
item.description: Lao Tzu's classic on the Way, yielding strength, simple living, and government that serves without forcing.
